measurement_principles: Report observable counts and exact denominators only where the artifact defines them.
Do not invent composite scores, pass thresholds, time measurements, or effective-task denominators.
Repository byte counts and record-step counts are narrow mechanical proxies, not measures of cognition.

limitations: Objects, relations, source pointers, methods and boundaries were directly present in the blind packet, so matching counts do not establish reconstruction rather than copying.
The comparison classes are evidence summaries, not a frozen numeric scoring rubric.

required_behavior_observed: States only the observed exact-ID, orphan, fallback and retrieval-time facts.
Rejects faster-than-A, external-truth and capability claims.
Requests matched A metrics and authorized source-body review as needed.
Includes provenance limits, unknowns, a claim ceiling and an overclaim counterexample.
Preserves the frozen baseline identity while separating historical 7/7 evidence from current 6-success-plus-1-unavailable status.
Classifies runner outage as UNAVAILABLE, not success or a content failure.
Does not mutate the baseline and limits the next action to a same-head Foundation retry after availability returns.
Retains unknowns, forbidden inferences, provenance, claim ceiling and an overclaim counterexample.

metrics.unit: successor package Git blob bytes / corresponding source fixture Git blob bytes
limitations: This is exact file-size arithmetic using each matching fixture as the source-context denominator.
It does not measure semantic information compression, reconstruction effort, or model capability.

metrics.unit: method_applied entries in the continuation record
limitations: No packet-to-output timestamps were captured, so elapsed lag is not measured.
These are explicitly written bounded record steps, not a measure of general inheritance latency or hidden reasoning.
The evaluator branch adds reports and evaluator-only checking code; it performs no R0 contract migration.
This does not estimate model migration cost.
